AI & HUMAN CO-WORK GOVERNING CHARTER
Binding rules for every human and AI using this workbook. Work is append-only, attributable, reviewable, and proof-linked.
Rule_ID | Binding Rule | Required Behavior | Prohibited Behavior | Failure Response | Owner | Status | Version

COWORK-001 | NEVER DELETE | Never delete rows, cells, sheets, records, comments, evidence, or prior wording. Preserve history. | Deletion, silent overwrite, clearing prior evidence, removing disagreement. | STOP work; mark HOLD; notify human owner; record attempted change in Change_Log. | Founder / Governor | ACTIVE | v1.0

COWORK-002 | CROSS OUT + SIGN + DATE | When a statement changes, apply strikethrough to the prior statement, retain it, add Superseded_By, Changed_By, Changed_At, reason, and append the replacement. | Editing history so the previous state disappears. | Reject change until attribution and date are present. | All workers | ACTIVE | v1.0

COWORK-003 | APPEND-ONLY CHANGE LOG | Every material change receives a Change_Log_ID and revision entry before release. | Unlogged changes or retroactive undocumented edits. | Mark output UNGOVERNED / HOLD. | AI Supervisor | ACTIVE | v1.0

COWORK-004 | READ JOB BEFORE WORK | Every AI reads the Charter, current task, worker envelope, project directive, relevant SOP, current truth, and prior handoff before acting. | Starting from memory alone or assuming scope. | Do not execute; create acceptance record first. | AI worker | ACTIVE | v1.0

COWORK-005 | ONE TASK OWNER | Every task has one accountable owner and named contributors/reviewers. | Orphan tasks or conflicting silent edits. | Route to human owner for assignment. | Task owner | ACTIVE | v1.0

COWORK-006 | HANDOFF WITH CONTEXT | Each handoff states what was requested, completed, verified, not verified, blockers, next action, files, and proof IDs. | “Done” without evidence or unresolved gaps. | Return handoff for completion. | Outgoing worker | ACTIVE | v1.0

COWORK-007 | PROOF BEFORE CLAIM | Use evidence classes and truth states. Never promote a design, prototype, narrative, or terminal-attested claim beyond its evidence. | Overclaiming runtime, deployment, validation, autonomy, or approval. | Downgrade truth state and log correction. | Governor / Reviewer | ACTIVE | v1.0

COWORK-008 | FAIL CLOSED ON RED FLAGS | Unauthorized changes, missing proof, conflicting truth, security risk, constitutional conflict, or core-impact uncertainty stop execution. | Self-approval or bypassing holds. | Set RED_FLAG/HOLD and escalate to Joshua/founder. | All workers | ACTIVE | v1.0

COWORK-009 | LEAST PRIVILEGE | Use only tools, files, systems, and data needed for the assigned job. | Broad access, unrelated searches, credential exposure. | Revoke action and record incident. | Supervisor / Governor | ACTIVE | v1.0

COWORK-010 | HUMAN AUTHORITY | Humans set purpose and approve high-impact decisions. AI may recommend, draft, test, and execute only within delegated authority. | AI changing protected architecture, policy, money, people, legal, safety, or production controls without approval. | HOLD pending named human approval. | Joshua / delegated owner | ACTIVE | v1.0

COWORK-011 | NO ARCHITECTURE DRIFT | Read and follow established APEX architecture. Treat suspected issues as hypotheses until traced and proven. | Renaming/reorganizing APEX because it looks unconventional. | Document hypothesis; do not change. | Architect / Governor | ACTIVE | v1.0

COWORK-012 | STAMP EVERY INTERACTION | Every governed AI work session or material interaction receives worker ID, timestamp, project/task IDs, acceptance, outcome, and proof/change references. | Anonymous or unattributed AI work. | Output cannot be promoted to current truth. | AI Office | ACTIVE | v1.0
